💻 Barclays Data Engineer Interview Questions💻
🚀 Cracking the Barclays Data Engineer Interview (3–4 YOE) 🔍💻
Hey LinkedIn fam! 👋
Over the past few weeks, I’ve been gathering real interview questions asked for the Data Engineer role at Barclays for professionals with 3–4 years of experience. 📊🧠
I’ve broken them down into four key areas with detailed explanations:
1️⃣ SQL – Query optimization, handling NULLs, second highest salary, and HAVING vs WHERE
2️⃣ Data Modeling – Normalization, star vs snowflake schema, and designing a banking data warehouse
3️⃣ Big Data Tools – Spark vs Hadoop, partitioning in Spark, and why Parquet is better than CSV
4️⃣ Python Coding – Handling large CSVs, managing missing data, and using decorators with examples
📘 Whether you're actively interviewing or brushing up on your concepts, this will give you a realistic view of the technical depth expected at top-tier firms like Barclays.
🔁 Feel free to like, save, or share this post with anyone preparing for a Data Engineering role.
💬 Grab the PDF and start learning .
